load_flax_diffusion_pipeline: load a pretrained Flax diffusion pipeline from a Hugging Face model ID or local directory
save_flax_pipeline: save a Flax diffusion pipeline and its parameters to a directory with optional hub push
convert_numpy_to_pil: convert a NumPy array of images to a list of PIL Image objects
register_pipeline_modules: register pipeline components like models and schedulers into a Flax diffusion pipeline
get_pipeline_components: retrieve all modules needed to initialize a Flax diffusion pipeline as a dictionary
